latin: Quare sex diebus dicitur deus omnia perfecisse.

mentions.context: Great Adam. Idel (2014, 38) notes Wirszubski that Keter, Tiferet, and Malkut had been linked to the Trinity in late thirteenth-century Castilian Kabbalism. 226. Pico, Conclusions (1998, 484–85): ‘Quare sex diebus dicitur deus omnia perfecisse…’ for instance. 227. Farmer (1998, 542). 228. Wirszubski (1989, 178).
